channel.title: The Sacramento Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sacramento Observer (sacobserver.com)

item.title: State grants $2.5M to support cannabis equity in Sacramento - The Sacramento Observer
item.description: The City of Sacramento has been awarded $2.5 million from the state's Cannabis Equity Grants Program to support equity efforts in the local cannabis industry and provide technical assistance and business support to participants in the City's Cannabis Opportunity Reinvestment and Equity (CORE) program.

item.title: The Reality of Being One of 600,000 Black Women Out of Work - The Sacramento Observer
item.description: Black women are facing an alarming rate of job loss, with up to 600,000 economically sidelined, due to the Trump administration's policies and the proliferation of AI use, as reflected in the story of Shana Pinnock-Glover, an Atlanta-based social media manager laid off from her national media company.

item.title: How Parents Can Advocate for Children With Disabilities - The Sacramento Observer
item.description: Parents are vital members of the IEP team and have the right to advocate for their child's needs, ensuring they receive the support and accommodations necessary to succeed in school.

item.title: We Can’t Win a War We Ignore - The Sacramento Observer
item.description: Black people in America are experiencing a coordinated, escalating assault on their citizenship, advancement, history, and future, and in order to fight back, they must unite and take collective action to rebuild their walls of unity, community, cooperation, self-determination, creativity, purpose, and faith.

item.title: Zion Baptist Church Prepares for Ribbon-Cutting at New East Baltimore Location - The Sacramento Observer
item.description: Zion Baptist Church will celebrate the opening of its new location at 1600 Harford Ave. with a weekend of events, representing years of faith, perseverance, and community-focused ministry.

item.title: 200 And Beyond; Sacramento Republic Lodge 200th Victory To Launch 2026 Campaign
item.description: The Sacramento Republic secured their 200th win in 13 seasons with a 2-0 victory over Tulsa F.C. and a 0-0 draw against Lexington F.C., with new faces contributing to the team's strong defense and physicality.

item.title: Climate Advocates Push Sac County Leaders To Act On Long-Delayed Climate Plan
item.description: Black community leaders and environmental activists confront the Sacramento County Board of Supervisors over years of delays to the Climate Emergency Response Plan.

item.title: Amid Debate, Bill To Redefine Child Neglect Clears Key Committee Hurdle
item.description: A bill aimed at changing how California defines “severe neglect” in child welfare cases sparks debate between advocates and law enforcement groups.

item.title: Early math screening proposed in California Senate Bill - The Sacramento Observer
item.description: Senate Bill 1067, introduced by Sen. Akilah Weber-Pierson, seeks to close California's racial achievement gap in education by requiring universal screening and early identification of math difficulties for students in kindergarten through second grade.

item.title: Nominations open for Mental Health Impact Awards 2024 - The Sacramento Observer
item.description: Deeper Cuts Therapy announces the Mental Health Impact Awards, recognizing individuals, organizations, and initiatives making a meaningful difference in mental health in Sacramento.
